displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump or 24VNA9 air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 95 is 9 short and 5 long
meaning: Compressor overcurrent lockout for 2 hours, elevated from fault 49 after 5 occurrences.
causes: High superheat, or the compressor operating outside its allowed envelope
Incoming supply voltage outside the rating plate, or loose power connections
Phase imbalance or miswired compressor leads at U, V, and W
Outdoor airflow too low or off
Inverter damage or compressor internal damage
diySteps: With power off, check the outdoor coil for ice or debris. The table pairs that look with troubleshooting the outdoor fan
Technician: check voltage against the rating plate, winding resistance and lead wiring, superheat, the suction transducer, charge, and replace the inverter or compressor only if those checks say so
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Code 49 was still resetting every 6 minutes. 95 is the 2-hour lockout.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
